sample_unit: clinical scenario questions (each rated by 7 expert obstetric anesthesiologists)

links.outcome: Expert-rated safety, accuracy, completeness of ChatGPT4 responses to labor analgesia scenarios
links.effect: Deemed safe in 73% of responses (27% unsafe); none unanimously safe across seven experts; accuracy 4/5 (partly accurate); completeness 3.5/5 (somewhat incomplete).
links.quote: ChatGPT4 was deemed safe in 73% of responses to the presented obstetric anesthesia clinical scenarios (27% of responses were deemed unsafe).

links.outcome: Clinical decision-making performance of ChatGPT4 versus expert standards despite prior success on knowledge exam questions
links.effect: Roughly a quarter of responses to clinical scenarios were unsafe, although the model has answered knowledge-based anesthesia questions with reasonable accuracy.
links.quote: In summary, approximately one quarter of all responses by ChatGPT4 were deemed unsafe by expert obstetric anesthesiologists.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4's performance on clinical labor analgesia scenarios using expert anesthesiologists to assess accuracy, safety, and completeness without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
